title: Empirical room-impulse-response geometry

dataset.title: University of Rochester room impulse response dataset

retrieval.reason: The execution container has no external DNS/network route. The official public Figshare API downloader is included for execution on a network-enabled machine.

synthetic_test_fixtures: Used only in unit tests to validate WAV decoding, response metrics, robust RDM construction, and end-to-end output generation. They are not empirical room data.

build_11_vibration_excerpt.reason: The smartphone movement recording and room impulse responses are not paired by shared excitation, room, device, or trial. Their RDMs are not directly comparable as matched systems.

research_context.associated_paper: Rutowski et al. (2024), Estimating direction of arrival in reverberant environments for wake-word detection using a single structural vibration sensor, JASA 156(4), 2619-2629.
research_context.note: These are results reported in the paper abstract, not calculations from the Rochester RIR archive or Build 12.

next_step: Run scripts/fetch_rochester_figshare.py, safely extract the archive, then execute build_12.py against the extracted WAV folder.
